about: icons2 (Forms / Strikes / Virtues). Medallion icons; labels are drawn by the game.

icon-rooted-form-64.note: Rooted Form = a wide, even, symmetric horse-style stance, front view. Technique: feet about two shoulder-widths apart and parallel, both knees bent equally and pushed out over the toes, hips low and level, back straight and upright, guard up (both fists in front at chin height, elbows down).

icon-follow-up-kick-64.note: Follow-up Kick = Strike adds a second kick (Kick Combo 1: front kick, front kick, inside kick, outside kick, spin kick; the icon shows the front kick). Side view facing right. Technique (front kick): support leg slightly bent with the foot flat, hips forward, kicking leg extended at chest height striking with the ball of the foot (toes pulled back), guard kept up. The first, lower kick is a soft ghost; a curved arrow shows the follow-up rising to the second.

icon-shield-of-respect-64.note: Shield of Respect = a gold shield with a student bowing (rei). Technique (standing bow): heels together, legs straight, bend about 30 degrees at the waist with a straight back, hands flat at the sides of the thighs, eyes down.

icon-beginners-stance-64.note: Beginner's Stance = plain relaxed standing, front view (Jay, 2026-10-25). Not the ready stance. Technique: feet together-ish in a natural stand (heels a little apart, toes slightly out), legs straight but not locked, back straight, shoulders relaxed, arms hanging loosely at the sides with open hands by the thighs, eyes forward.

icon-stance-ready-64.note: Ready = the open leg stance, front view (Jay, 2026-10-25; this is the drawing that was #277's Beginner's Stance). Technique: feet shoulder-width apart and parallel, knees soft, back straight, both fists closed in front of the stomach/belt, eyes forward.

icon-flowing-form-64.note: RETIRED (Jay, 2026-10-25): replaced by Fighting stance (incoming-art/stances, #300). Kept until renames are decided. Flowing Form = light on your feet. Side view facing right, a light fighting stance. Technique: weight on the balls of the feet with the back heel raised, knees bent, lead hand forward, rear hand by the chin. Soft motion arcs behind show the movement.

icon-quick-combo-64.note: Quick Combo = practiced combos flow smoothly (Kick Combo 2: Kick Combo 1 plus 3 jumping spin kicks). Side view facing right: a round kick at middle height striking with the instep, support foot turned, body leaning back for balance, guard up. A sweeping arc shows the kick's path and soft chevrons show speed.

icon-second-wind-64.note: Second Wind (Great Effort) = pushing on when you're tired. Side view facing right: the student rises from one knee. Technique: back knee on the floor, front foot flat with the knee over the ankle, back straight, one hand pressing on the front knee to stand. Soft rising swirls show the energy coming back.

icon-perfect-discipline-64.note: Perfect Discipline (Self-Discipline) = control and precision. Side view facing right: the student kneels in seiza, calm and still. Technique: kneeling with the shins on the floor and sitting on the heels, back straight, hands flat on the thighs, eyes forward. Soft still-water ripples on the floor show calm control.
